name: Dayline
summary: Five appointments on one confident rising line. The next prayer comes forward in electric citron.
why: Five upright gates share a continuous timeline, turning the app's central job into one compact sign: keep the five daily prayers in view and make the next one clear. The diagonal gives a familiar schedule structure its own silhouette.
risk: The meaning depends on the five-prayer story; without the app name it can suggest a schedule or an equalizer.
